vl53l1x_spike_track.spike_001_vl53l1x_bringup: VALIDATED (commit ec9fb58, chip-identity addendum 73a3a12). Sensor/wiring/I2C all confirmed good — no hardware fault. Key gotcha found: the Pimoroni `vl53l1x` python library's open() defaults to reset=False; skipping reset=True causes ranging to degrade to 100% failure (Phase Fail/Signal Fail) after repeated start/stop cycles within one power session, even though I2C stays fully healthy. HARD REQUIREMENT recorded in MANIFEST.md Requirements: any future VL53L1X use MUST call tof.open(reset=True).
vl53l1x_spike_track.spike_002_accuracy_comparison: PARTIAL (commit a9ba8c9). VL53L1X agrees closely with ultrasonic (within ~2-3cm, explained by mount offset) from 10cm out to ~50-60cm. Beyond that it does NOT fail safely -- it reports a confident but WRONG short distance (phase wrap-around artifact) rather than an honest error code. A longer 140ms timing budget (vs ~33ms default) improved this to a smooth, monotonic saturation near the same ~55-60cm ceiling (better/more predictable, but still wrong at true 100cm). Ultrasonic, by contrast, stayed accurate across the entire 10-100cm+ tested range.
vl53l1x_spike_track.core_finding_inverts_seed_001: SEED-001 assumed VL53L1X would become PRIMARY with ultrasonic demoted to fallback. The evidence says the opposite: ULTRASONIC SHOULD STAY PRIMARY (only sensor that reliably covers 60cm-100cm+ range), and VL53L1X is at best a candidate NEAR-FIELD (<=60cm) precision cross-check -- which happens to overlap the existing obstacle-stop threshold band (STOP_THRESHOLD_CM/RESUME_THRESHOLD_CM in autonomy/behavior.py, 20-35cm) where ultrasonic's own known weakness (soft/angled/low-profile surfaces) matters most. This is recorded in MANIFEST.md Requirements. SEED-001 itself has NOT yet been updated to reflect this reversal -- do that before this seed is ever promoted to a real plan.
